description: Implementation of the SkipCutBuffer class for audio data processing in Android's stagefright media framework, including buffer management, skipping, and cutting functionalities.

classes.name: SkipCutBuffer
classes.description: A buffer class that manages skipping and cutting segments of media data, with internal buffer management and read/write operations.

methods.name: SkipCutBuffer
methods.description: Constructor initializing buffer parameters for skip and cut durations based on number of 16-bit channels.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Submits a MediaBuffer or other buffer type to the skip/cut buffer, processing and adjusting buffer ranges.

methods.name: submitInternal
methods.description: Template method handling internal buffer submission logic for different buffer types.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Resets buffer read/write heads and padding to initial skip state.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes data into the internal buffer, reallocating if necessary.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads data from the internal buffer, respecting back padding.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the current size of data in the buffer.
